metadata.name: FRACTAL DRIVE
metadata.description:
You are not looking at a picture. You are inside a living corridor — endless geometry folding around you, light pulsing like a heartbeat, a path that never quite repeats.

Every piece is a different flight through the same impossible architecture: gold shafts, neon halls, deep violet atriums, crimson twists. Some glide soft. Some rush. Some feel like falling through a dream you almost remember.

No two journeys feel the same. The walls breathe. The score follows. The tunnel keeps going.

metadata.Description:
PDM-001 / silk road
original 1/1 watercolor
Pattern & Decoration Movement (P&D) and minimalism. These two opposing philosophies cannot exist without each other. By combining these two aspects of stillness (minimalism) and movement (Pattern & Decoration Movement) and adding imperfection, a single work of art is created. It is precisely because they are in simplicity that their flamboyance and movement stand out. They are not opposites, but one and the same. And each pattern is a visualization of the accumulation and memories of my life so far. This is why emotions overflow from the patterns and become one with the inorganic, spatial minimalism.

metadata.title: Prey Instincts (Fluid Acrylic + Digital)
metadata.author: iffy Wisdom
metadata.description: I enjoy pareidolia as part of my process. Cloud-gazing. Finding forms and figures in patterns that do not actually possess them. In this painting I imagined I saw an eagle-cryptid bird-of-prey facing off against a cranky floating red demon with two little crocodiles at his feet. So I painted that.

metadata.name: Bitcoin Jelly — Block 42,789
metadata.description:
Logo Morning

A common sat. An uncommon morning.

A one-of-one interactive artwork celebrating a remarkable moment in Bitcoin's earliest history.

On February 27, 2010, Bitcoin block 42,789 carried a single coinbase transaction, just 216 bytes of block data, and a 50 BTC mining subsidy. Its timestamp was 03:03:10 UTC.
